instruction: An elegant studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, the redhead woman (R1) stands on the left, wearing a light blue shirt draped off her shoulder over a brown top, with her right hand touching her neck as she looks slightly away with a confident, serene expression. On the right, the dark-haired woman (R2) stands facing forward, wearing a white wrap blouse with puffed sleeves, with her left hand resting gently on her collarbone as she looks directly at the camera with a calm, poised expression. The two stand close together under soft, diffused studio lighting that creates a neutral, warm color palette.
